key_insight: An evidence-driven multi-agent AI system combines automated proton radiotherapy planning with conversational refinement to better balance competing treatment objectives.
clinical_relevance: For head and neck cancers, the approach could help planners tailor proton therapy plans to physician priorities; this is treatment-planning research, not drug discovery.
method: A PPO-trained reinforcement learning policy generates five candidate plans per patient.
Planning, chatbot and evaluation agents support natural-language refinement using prior plans and clinical metrics.
The Qwen3-14B planning agent is post-trained with supervised fine-tuning and group relative policy optimization.
evidence_signal: The framework was trained and evaluated using 21 patients and 50 plans selected for refinement; post-trained Qwen3-14B showed better instruction-following, retrieval and planning trade-offs than the base model.
watch_item: The small patient cohort and absence of reported prospective clinical outcomes limit conclusions about generalizability and patient benefit.
paper_title: An Evidence-Driven Multi-Agent Compound AI System for Head and Neck Proton Radiotherapy Planning
